task: Replace the generic checkbox-only Multiselect for the Scheduler page Project filter with the shared ProjectSelector (with search), preserving select/deselect and URL behaviour (EPMCDME-16068).

key_reasoning.reason: Acceptance criteria are defined, but open decisions remain: single vs multiple ProjectSelector mode (deselect and selectDefault behaviour), and the option source changing from projects-with-schedulers to the user's projects. Scored M, not higher, because the multiple + array-value reading is the low-risk default.

Closest pattern is the Filters Custom/renderCustomFilter dispatch (Assistants, Skills, Workflows) plus the Analytics ProjectSelector embed (label='' fullWidth multiple). No page embeds ProjectSelector inside Filters, and the array vs string value contract with handleApply (?.[0]) is a real trap. No security, performance or irreversible concerns; the change is a trivial rollback. Scored M.
